name: @z7ping/agent-lens
description: Local observability and replay for AI coding agents, rebuilt around a canonical evidence model.

scripts.check:web-presentation: node scripts/check-web-presentation.mjs && node scripts/check-release-info.mjs && node scripts/check-review-contract.mjs
scripts.check:desktop-shell: node --check apps/desktop/src/bootstrap.mjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/external-links.mjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/integration.mjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/main.mjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/update-check.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-desktop-runtime.mjs
scripts.desktop:win: npm run check:web-presentation && npm run check:brand-assets && npm run check:desktop-shell && npm run build:dist && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:win --workspace @agent-lens/desktop
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run check:web-presentation && npm run check:brand-assets && npm run check:desktop-shell && npm run build:dist && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:mac --workspace @agent-lens/desktop
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run check:web-presentation && npm run check:brand-assets && npm run check:desktop-shell && npm run build:dist && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:linux --workspace @agent-lens/desktop
scripts.release:check: npm run check:web-presentation && npm run check:brand-assets && npm run check:desktop-shell && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:dist && npm run smoke:dist && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepack: npm run check:web-presentation && npm run check:brand-assets && npm run check:desktop-shell && npm run build:dist

author: 7ping <z7ping@outlook.com>
